body: Fixed in d503f0c9b. Added regression coverage for null and non-record boundary/input values asserting `boundary_record_required` and `inputs_record_required`, plus the filesystem fail-closed hashing regression.

Fixed in d503f0c9b. `sha256File` now wraps path resolution, existence checking, and hashing inside one `try` block, and `sourceArtifactRef` uses a guarded existence helper so filesystem errors fail closed as `exists: false` / `sha256: null`.
